context: Map 57 (Stadium Cup lobby), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: This facility lets you conduct battles similar to Stadium championships.

context: Map 57 (Stadium Cup lobby), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: This facility holds battles for Pika Cup, Fancy Cup, Poké Cup, and Little Cup. Each cup has its own rules and restrictions.

context: Map 57 (Stadium Cup lobby), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: The Pika Cup is open to Pokémon level 15 to 20.

context: Map 57 (Stadium Cup lobby), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: Choose three Pokémon to enter.\n However, the total level of all three can't be higher than 50.

context: Map 57 (Stadium Cup lobby), event 7, page 1: Show Text; Same text: ev007.p1.c043
english: Also, certain exotic kinds of Pokémon may not enter.

context: Map 57 (Stadium Cup lobby), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: The Fancy Cup is open to baby Pokémon level 25 to 30.

context: Map 57 (Stadium Cup lobby), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: Choose three Pokémon to enter.\n However, the total level of all three can't be higher than 80.

context: Map 57 (Stadium Cup lobby), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: Also, very huge or very tall Pokémon may not enter the Fancy Cup.

context: Map 57 (Stadium Cup lobby), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: The height limit is 2 meters, and the weight limit is 20 kilograms for the Fancy Cup.

context: Map 57 (Stadium Cup lobby), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: The Poké Cup is open to Pokémon level 50 to 55.

context: Map 57 (Stadium Cup lobby), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: Choose three Pokémon to enter.\n However, the total level of all three can't be higher than 155.

context: Map 57 (Stadium Cup lobby), event 7, page 1: Show Choices option

context: Map 57 (Stadium Cup lobby), event 7, page 1: Show Choices option

context: Map 57 (Stadium Cup lobby), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: The Little Cup is open to baby Pokémon at level 5 that are capable of evolving.

context: Map 57 (Stadium Cup lobby), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: Choose three Pokémon to enter a single battle, or four for a double battle.

context: Map 57 (Stadium Cup lobby), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: Also, in the Little Cup, moves that deal a set amount of damage, like Dragon Rage and SonicBoom, will always miss.

context: Map 57 (Stadium Cup lobby), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: In Stadium Cups, there are several rules to keep in mind.

context: Map 57 (Stadium Cup lobby), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: First, two Pokémon in the same team can't be both asleep or both frozen at the same time.

context: Map 57 (Stadium Cup lobby), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: Also, you can't choose two of the same kind of Pokémon, or two Pokémon holding the same item.

context: Map 57 (Stadium Cup lobby), event 7, page 1: Show Text
english: Finally, if a Pokémon uses Selfdestruct or Explosion to make all remaining Pokémon faint at the same time, that Pokémon's trainer loses.
